newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold, silver prices fall sharply after rise.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold, silver prices fall sharply after rise.

text.p: Indian gold and silver prices fell sharply on Thursday on profit-taking and weaker world market trends after opening higher, dealers said.
On Wednesday gold was up by five rupees per 10 grammes and silver was up by 40 rupees per kg.
"Improved arrivals of the imported metal also capped today early gains," one dealer said.
Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 grammes) opened higher at 59,300 rupees against previous closing of 58,900 rupees but fell and ended at 58,900 rupees.
"Sentiment at the close remained subdued but some traders were expecting fresh physical buying tomorrow. Market may bounce back again," one broker said.
